marketbeat_parse.analyst_ratings_note: Historical monthly aggregate ratings are validated but cost 2 credits and add no individual broker identity; forecast already provides current/1m/3m/1y decision horizons.
marketbeat_parse.selection: Within the full Committee/Watch or Top-300 fallback, reuse safely resolved MarketBeat identities first; fill remaining slots by Committee priority, score and analyst depth; maximum 3 issuer-level cross-checks per run.
marketbeat_parse.issuer_link_rule: A US analyst proxy is accepted only when MarketBeat search also contains a same-name candidate carrying the local Yahoo ticker base.

rules.marketbeat_local_proxy_blend: 70% local/canonical signal + 30% MarketBeat issuer signal when both exist; 100% of the sole available signal otherwise
